instructions: You are {name}. You live with other people in a world that has laws.
Time passes in ticks. Each tick you know the laws in force and what you perceive, and you may act with your tools.
You think and speak in English. End every tick with a short thought, one or two sentences.

observation.noWinter: under the current laws there is no winter
observation.self: YOU: health {hp}/{maxHp}, hunger {hunger}, carrying {food} food and {wood} wood; actions left this tick: {actions}; {shelter}.
observation.laws:
THE LAWS OF THE WORLD (from the law book, revision {revision}):
{laws}
observation.changed:
LAWS CHANGED SINCE YOUR LAST TICK:
{changes}

look.here: You are at ({x},{y}) on {biome}: food {food}, wood {wood}{shelter}.
look.map: The world is {w}x{h} tiles; x grows east, y grows south. Water cannot be entered.

act.moved: you are now at ({x},{y}) {biome}: food {food}, wood {wood}{shelter}
act.gathered: gathered {amount} {resource}; you now carry {food} food and {wood} wood
act.shelterExists: there is already a shelter here
act.shelterCost: a shelter costs {cost} wood; you carry {wood}
act.tooFar: {name} is too far: they must be on your tile or an adjacent one
act.restStarving: you rested but you are starving: no healing

tools.look: Look around: nearby tiles with food, wood or shelters, people in sight. Free.
tools.move: Step to an adjacent tile. Costs one action.
tools.gather: Gather food or wood from the tile you stand on. Costs one action.
tools.eatAmount: how much (default: as much as needed)
tools.build: Build a shelter on your tile with wood you carry. Costs one action.
tools.give: Give food or wood to someone on your tile or an adjacent one. Costs one action.
tools.say: Say something to one person (by name) or to "all". Arrives next tick. Free.
tools.rest: Rest to recover health. Costs one action.
tools.remember: Write something in your personal notebook, to remember it in later ticks.
tools.recall: Read the notes in your notebook that match a search.

mock.hungry: I am hungry and have nothing to eat: looking for food.
mock.staying: Staying under the shelter until the cold passes.
mock.heading: Heading to the shelter at ({x},{y}).
mock.failed: Not everything went as planned ({n} actions failed).
mock.sayShelter: Winter is coming. There is a shelter at ({x},{y}).
mock.sayNoShelter: Winter is coming and there is no shelter. I am bringing wood to ({x},{y}).
mock.saySpare: I have food to spare at ({x},{y}).
mock.sayWhere: I am at ({x},{y}). Food here is {state}.
